column6: Initial-estimate email not sent to appraiser (Hachshara claims)
column7: In claims against Hachshara Insurance, the appraiser does not receive the automated email requesting an initial damage estimate. Verify the trigger condition and dispatch flow for this insurer.
Opening a new claim is very slow. Move heavy processing to asynchronous background jobs and/or optimize performance so the user is never blocked.

column6: Bafi import – filter by specific claim, digits-only claim number
column7: The Bafi import must be filtered by the specific claim, and the claim number must be parsed as digits only.

column6: Email auto-assignment and form placement in document sections
column7: Automatic assignment of emails to "Incoming Correspondence" does not work correctly, and forms are not placed in their designated document sections.

column6: Bafi session disconnects on every document pull
column7: Every document pull from Bafi logs the user out of Bafi and forces a new login. The session must persist during and after the pull.

column6: Incident-scene photos from WhatsApp filed under "Appraiser Photos"
column7: Incident-scene photos that the customer sends via WhatsApp are still being filed under "Appraiser Photos". Route them to the "Incident Scene Photos & Videos" document section (see roadmap item for the new section).

column6: Partial save at every stage of a claim
column7: Ensure that at any stage a partially populated claim can be opened, any single detail – however small – edited, and saved, without being blocked by mandatory fields or mandatory documents.

column6: Cannot save a single added document after questionnaire (Third-Party claim)
column7: After the customer completes the questionnaire, entering Edit mode and adding one document (e.g. a consent form) does not allow updating the claim unless all other documents are provided. Mandatory-field and mandatory-document validations block small incremental updates in the Edit Claim window. Observed on a Third-Party claim – same root cause as the policy-claim partial-save issue discussed previously. Allow saving any single change.
column19: #1 · 17/11/26 10:00 · Aviv Ashkenazi: Same issue we discussed yesterday on the policy claim – partial progress cannot be saved in Edit Claim because of mandatory fields/documents. This case is a Third-Party claim.

column6: Prevent data loss when a claim gets stuck
column7: When a claim gets stuck (e.g. a large file upload or another failure), the claim must not be lost unsaved – auto-save a draft and recover gracefully.
column12: Dev Request Portal – Racheli Asraf requests

column6: Bafi pulls documents from the general folder instead of the claim folder
column7: Reported live during a session with Randa (17.11.2026, 10:04): Bafi still pulls documents from the client's general documents folder instead of the Claims folder. In Bafi every client has a Claims folder with a sub-folder per claim containing its own documents – the import must target the specific claim folder.

column6: Emotional distress & linkage interest in claim amounts
column7: In the amounts section of the Edit Claim window, add "Emotional Distress" and "Linkage Interest" categories – tailored especially for attorneys.

column6: Auto-detect and auto-fill the insurance company
column7: Auto-populate the Insurance Company field from the notice-form data and the coverage check, so the user does not need to set it manually when it already exists.

column6: Vehicle-identification guidance in the notice form
column7: While filling in the notice form, show clear guidance on which vehicle is meant – the claimant's vehicle or the third party's vehicle.

column6: Save draft at any stage of an agent claim
column7: In agent claims, allow saving a draft at any stage of claim creation, even with minimal data.
Add a partner-user option in which two users both hold admin permissions and all cases are fully visible and transparent to each other.
For total-loss vehicles the system currently calculates by damage amount instead of vehicle value. The claim should equal the price-list value minus the salvage-value offset.

column6: Damage report only (Form 68) – insurer's own customer
column7: Allow submitting a damage report only (Form 68) for damage caused by the insurance company's own customer – not a policy claim, not a third-party claim and not an agent claim. No garage, appraiser or damage-location selection and no mandatory fields.

column6: Policy notification only – third party hit, no own damage
column7: Allow submitting a claim as a notification to the policy only, for cases where the insured hit a third party but has no damage of their own – without mandatory fields such as repairing garage, appraiser report, appraiser name, etc.
Add a smart button that translates all on-screen content to Hebrew in a single click.

column6: Separate the notes mechanism from reminders
column7: Create a dedicated Notes button, display notes in the claim view card, and persist them so they do not disappear after re-login.

column6: Reorder Claim View – communication history above documents
column7: Move the communication-history section above the documents section in the Claim View window (higher priority).

column6: New "Incident Scene Photos & Videos" document section
column7: In Edit Claim, add a new document section named "Incident Scene Photos & Videos".

column6: View linked documents in the built-in Outlook
column7: In the built-in Outlook, allow viewing all documents linked to the claim when composing a new email.

column6: Remember recipient addresses when sending from a claim
column7: When sending an email from the claim row, remember previously used addresses (both To and CC).
When sending an email from the claim row, allow editing and changing the email subject.
Automatically capture the insurance company from an uploaded form, and auto-fill the "Handling Garage" based on the logged-in user.
Generate Form 68 from the insurance companies in one click, and generate a non-filing declaration / send an automatic email to obtain it.

column6: Harel, Securitas and automatic consent form
column7: Add Harel to the garage-arrangement list, add Securitas to the coverage check, and automatically insert the consent form after signing.

column6: Auto-extract the claim number from insurer emails
column7: Automatically extract the claim number from the insurer's reply email and insert it into the claim card and the claims table.

column6: Unsent-claim alert and reminder search by date
column7: Show a prominent alert when a claim fails to be sent from the portal, and allow searching by date in the All Reminders screen.
Add a preview button for the demand letter inside the Edit Claim window, so the letter can be reviewed before sending.

column6: Claim-specific note in the demand letter
column7: Allow adding, from the claim window, a note to that claim's demand letter only – without changing the global letter template and without affecting demand letters of other claims.

column6: "Days in treatment" component in the Garages report
column7: Add a "Days in treatment" tracking component to the Garages report.
One-click request to the lienholder for a letter of intent approving the release of funds, including managing the correspondence with the lienholder.
Send the "Lien Release for Insurance Proceeds" form to the customer in one click, to be signed by the lienholder and returned to the agent.

column6: Auto-fill the notice form from the WhatsApp questionnaire
column7: Allow the WhatsApp questionnaire to automatically populate the notice form.
If the WhatsApp bot receives an answer that the customer has no insurance, trigger a task to sign a non-filing declaration (attorney-verified).
Generate an inbound and outbound communication report per customer (for use if legal proceedings are opened).
Automatically detect a total loss based on the depreciation percentages in the appraiser report.
column12: Dev Request Portal – Racheli Asraf requests

column6: Remember insurers and leasing companies entered under "Other"
column7: Remember insurance companies added under the "Other" field (e.g. leasing companies) for re-use later.
column12: Dev Request Portal – Racheli Asraf requests

column6: Filter claims not yet sent to the insurer
column7: Allow filtering by the status "not sent to insurer", with a warning icon similar to Shomera, Direct Insurance and Phoenix.
column12: Dev Request Portal – Racheli Asraf requests

column6: Per-user work allocation and action audit trail
column7: For accounts where a whole team works on the same mailbox, enable allocation by user and a full audit trail of who opened the case, who edited it and further actions – for reporting.
column12: Dev Request Portal – Racheli Asraf requests

column6: Duplicate a claim for a second insurer
column7: Allow duplicating an existing claim in order to send it to a second insurance company when there are two third parties.
